sources.title: Canadian Army launches MINERVA's first innovation challenge at 4 Canadian Division Support Base Petawawa
sources.locator: A field demonstration to showcase the CA's real-world operational needs to industry
sources.summary: The official National Defence article describes the Canadian Army's True North Precision innovation challenge, its operational problem, desired outcomes, IDEaS sponsorship, and up to $2.1 million in development funding.

fieldEvidence.excerpt: The official article identifies the Canadian Army's True North Precision challenge as an IDEaS-backed effort to improve target acquisition using low-cost small drones, with up to $2.1 million in development funding.
The official article explains that affordable small uncrewed aircraft often lack the geolocation accuracy needed for effective sensor-to-shooter integration and indirect-fire coordination.

The article says proposed solutions are intended to improve battlefield awareness, decision making, soldier survivability, sensor-to-shooter integration, and resilience in harsh environmental conditions.

demandSource.summary: A Canadian Army and IDEaS innovation challenge seeking low-cost small-drone laser-ranging approaches to improve target acquisition, indirect-fire coordination, battlefield awareness, and resilience, with up to $2.1 million in development funding.

requirements.title: Low-cost drone laser ranging for indirect fire
requirements.problemStatement: Affordable small uncrewed aerial systems are accessible to frontline units but often lack the geolocation accuracy required for effective target acquisition, sensor-to-shooter integration, and indirect-fire coordination.
requirements.desiredEndState: Low-cost small-drone targeting and range-finding approaches should improve situational awareness, decision making, soldier survivability, indirect-fire integration, and operational resilience in harsh environmental conditions.
requirements.publicCaveat: Public-source alignment only. This is not procurement eligibility, endorsement, customer interest, or a classified requirement.
